name: Kek Lok Si Temple
desc: Hillside mega-temple stacking pagodas like it's showing off. During lantern season it glows so hard your camera roll taps out.

name: Penang Hill
desc: Ride the funicular up, watch George Town shrink into fairy lights, eat overpriced ice cream anyway. The cool air up top is free.

name: George Town Street Art Trail
desc: Free scavenger hunt through heritage lanes — kids on bicycle murals, cats, swings. Your whole feed for zero ringgit.

name: Chew Jetty
desc: A wooden clan village on stilts over the sea, still lived-in. Sunset here costs nothing and looks like a million bucks.

name: Cheong Fatt Tze Blue Mansion
desc: An indigo courtyard mansion so photogenic it's been in movies. Tour it once, redecorate your imaginary house forever.

name: Penang National Park
desc: Tiny national park, huge flex: jungle trail out to a turtle beach and a canopy walk. Basically a free adventure movie.

name: Batu Ferringhi Beach
desc: Long sandy stretch where the night market rolls out as the sun drops. Haggle a little, snack a lot, sleep happy.

name: Gurney Drive Promenade
desc: Seafront strip where hawker legends work the woks after dark. Wok steam plus sea breeze equals the perfect broke night out.

name: Penang Botanic Gardens
desc: Monkey-patrolled green escape locals call the Waterfall Gardens. Free morning walks, judgmental macaques included.

name: Fort Cornwallis
desc: Star-shaped fort from 1786 with cannons still eyeing the strait. Cheap history, sea views, zero gym membership required.
